data.title: 不知火舞 · 灶前的大和抚子
data.description: 她系着围裙在灶前做杂煮与便当，动作娴熟温柔；便当盒里给某人的那份明显更用心——格斗场上的女王在厨房只是普通的女孩子。
data.action: 她系着围裙在灶前做杂煮与便当，动作娴熟温柔
data.promptProse: Mai Shiranui places the last vegetables into a carefully arranged lunch box beside the soup pot. Her red apron covers a cream long-sleeved shirt and dark trousers, high ponytail kept clear of the food as brown eyes narrow with a pleased smile. The medium portrait includes chopsticks and cooking surface behind her hands. Warm kitchen light illuminates food colors and apron folds, with small compartment shadows and soft steam reflections above the pot.
